sections.section_title: LTDC layer x CLUT write register (LTDC_LxCLUTWR)
sections.text_helper: Section 43.7.43 "LTDC layer x CLUT write register (LTDC_LxCLUTWR)" in chapter 43 (LCD-TFT display controller (LTDC)), RM0486 Rev 4, page 2146.
sections.section_content:
Address offset: 0x150 + 0x100 * (x - 1), (x = 1 to 2)
Reset value: 0x00000000
This register defines the CLUT address and the RGB value. The CLUT write register must
only be configured during blanking period or if the layer is disabled. The CLUT can be
enabled or disabled in LTDC_LxCR. The CLUT is only meaningful for L8, AL44, and
AL88pixel format.
Bits 31:24 CLUTADD[7:0]: CLUT address
This bitfield configures the CLUT address (color position within the CLUT)
ofeachRGBvalue.
Bits 23:16 RED[7:0]: Red value
This bitfield configures the red value.
Bits 15:8 GREEN[7:0]: Green value
This bitfield configures the green value.
Bits 7:0 BLUE[7:0]: Blue value
This bitfield configures the blue value.
